title: net1 v6 on real cellular traces: accuracy per LCF, alarms, and LCFs over time (R4.1, R4.2, R2.4)
description: net1 v6 (seed 0, model-v6-inputs) never saw a cellular trace: its links hold constant or stepping capacity. Here Cubic, BBRv1, Reno and Vegas (observed controllers in its training) run alone and against a Cubic flow from 0 s for 30 s on the 27 cellular links of experiments/heldout.py (Mahimahi's AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon traces, each link with its test link's one-way delay and buffer in BDPs, campaign seed 31), steps kept. Then: experiments/net1_train.py --eval reports each LCF's 90% coverage, R^2, mean absolute error and log loss on all of them (accuracy/report.json, view ood_cellular); experiments/r2_alarms.py scores the alarms on them as a positive family, with thresholds from net1 v4's validation links of the 30 s broad data and false alarms on its test links (exp-data-net1-broad-30s-73), links net1 v6 did not train on (alarms/summary.md); and experiments/lcf_timeseries.py plots, for the Cubic and the BBRv1 episode whose capacity varies most, every LCF's truth, belief mean and 90% interval against time (lcf-*.png, with each LCF's error in lcf-*.txt).
prepare: uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-cellular-30" --split test --family cellular --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --stock cubic,bbr,reno,vegas; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-cellular-30/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-cellular-30"
collect: N1="$IN/m/net1-v6-s0.pt"; C="$OUT/c-cellular-30"; uv run python experiments/net1_train.py "$OUT/accuracy" --spec experiments/specs/net1v4.json --set dropout=0.05 --set width=512 --data "$C" --eval "$N1" --ood cellular="$C"; uv run python experiments/r2_alarms.py "$OUT/alarms" --net1 v6="$N1" --calib "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" --negatives "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" --positives cellular="$C"; for c in cubic bbr; do uv run --with matplotlib==3.10.0 python experiments/lcf_timeseries.py "$OUT/lcf-$c.png" "$N1" "$C" --controller "$c" > "$OUT/lcf-$c.txt"; done
